caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped garden parterre with intricate, symmetrical patterns outlined in green, set against a tan or beige background. The central feature consists of multiple rounded, interconnected shapes, each bordered with green and filled with a brownish-tan color. These shapes are distributed evenly throughout the oval, creating an ornate, decorative design. Surrounding the oval shape is a border marked with evenly spaced white circles, and along the top and sides, there are small, white architectural structures resembling lamp posts or finials. At the top left and top right corners, outside the oval, there are two brown birdhouse-like structures. At the bottom left, there is a white outlined arch and gate, drawn with straight and curved lines. On the right side within the oval border, the text “Parterre Claremont 1855” is written in brown. The overall composition uses green, brown, tan, and white as the primary colors.
title: Parterre Claremont
